text: Library since 9. Did the 2019 chem paper. 38/80. Stared at the stoichiometry question for twenty minutes.
Mum asked about JUPAS again at lunch. I said I'm still thinking and she went quiet. 我知佢係擔心我。
Tired. But I explained moles to Jason's big sister over WhatsApp and she got it. Weird how teaching it makes it click for me too. 182 days until the DSE.
